about.title: About me
about.text: Full-Stack Developer specialized in building modern web applications with Laravel, Inertia.js and React. Solid experience in the PHP ecosystem, MySQL databases and responsive interface design with Tailwind CSS. Software Engineer passionate about building high-performance digital products with clean, scalable code.

items.description: Led the development of two key web applications: a support ticket management system (Laravel 12) and an inventory control platform (Laravel 11). Implemented role-based authentication, designed optimized MySQL databases, and built a modern SPA front-end with React, Tailwind CSS and Inertia.js, plus RESTful APIs.

Building applications that support daily operations and improve service response times. Integrating features for clearer control of equipment and resources, and making continuous improvements to boost internal work efficiency.
Provided comprehensive technical support, resolving hardware and software incidents. Performed equipment diagnostics, component replacements, software installation and general maintenance.

items.title: Support Ticket System
items.description: Complete ticket management system with role-based authentication (admin, technicians, end users), status tracking and dashboard.

items.description: Inventory management platform with optimized relational database, efficient SQL queries and modern SPA interface.
